verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile is a mobile client for GitHub repositories, pull requests, issues and Copilot agent tasks, not a terminal or SSH client, so scp/sftp transfers to arbitrary remote hosts fall outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any SSH or file-transfer capability that would make this axis apply.

support.subject: As a developer, I can transfer files to and from remote hosts via scp and sftp using my configured keys
